'''Circarpous VI''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Circarpous Major]] in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]]. Located in the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], it was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]].
